scope: 已确认吉他声部或明确来源吉他声明的曲谱；器种、其他声部、人数与版本疑点逐条保留。
new_musescore_scope: Frozen PDMX v9 acoustic-guitar selection plus individually reviewed guitar-related scores; unresolved additional roles and ensemble sizes remain explicit.
rules: Native identity, source title, original attribution, licensing and format locators remain unchanged.
A broad admission requires an active, explicitly declared guitar role in the actual MXL, corroborating printed PDF evidence, and three verified record-bound formats.
Bare part counts, MIDI patches, the hosting website and generic instrument register names do not establish instrumentation or player counts.
A broad admission with unresolved roles, alternatives or collective desks receives guitar_unspecified, never a precise solo/duo/trio/quartet conclusion.
No guitar role established means no admission through this policy; clear other instrumentation remains a recorded review outcome.
Source declarations and file observations have separate evidence labels; this policy does not change acquisition permissions or frozen download scopes.
